Dashboard reporting services

KPI dashboard for small business decisions, not just prettier charts

Data Fort designs dashboard reporting services around the numbers owners and staff need to review each month. A KPI dashboard for small business should make sales reporting, customer retention analysis, inventory reporting, rebooking, refill retention, product performance, service revenue, and margin visibility easier to understand.

Dashboard scope

Reports that match how the business runs

The goal is not a generic dashboard. The goal is a reporting view that helps a pharmacy owner, retailer, e-commerce operator, clinic manager, or staff lead see what changed and where to act.

  • Revenue and sales reporting Monthly trends, category performance, product performance, service revenue, and changes worth investigating.
  • Retention and repeat behaviour Repeat purchases, refill patterns, lapsed customers, rebooking, no-shows, and loyalty signals.
  • Inventory and margin visibility Slow movers, stockout risk, margin by category, product mix, and cash tied up in inventory.
